newsitem.title: USA: Enron seeks federal OK for Portland merger.
newsitem.headline: Enron seeks federal OK for Portland merger.

text.p: Enron Corp said Friday it has filed an application with the Federal Energy Regulatory Commission for its previously announced merger with Portland General Corp, the parent company of Portland General Electric.
Both companies approved the merger July 22, but the deal awaits approval from both companies' shareholders and the Oregon Public Utility Commission.
Enron said the merger will allow it to compete in a deregulated energy market by diversifying its fuel resources to include gas, oil, coal, hydro and renewables.
The merger agreement, which is expected to be approved by regulators in mid 1997, calls for Portland General's management team to remain in place.
